content.value: i) 10 clock cycles for each memory read access when cache memory does not exist.
ii) 17 clock cycles to load a block into cache when cache exists and single clock cycle to access cache. Suppose a typical program in which 20% of its instructions program a read or write operation.
Calculate improvement of the performance for using cache if the hit in the cache are 0.9 for instructions and 0.8 for data.
